content: Mira Castellanos covers the payments on-call rota through December.
Castellanos reviews every schema change to the payout tables before it merges.
She is on parental leave from March; Tobias Wren takes her review queue.
Wren owns the Friday deploy checklist and signs off each release train.
Asked for pager alerts to go to the team channel instead of SMS.
A failed posting is retried three times with exponential backoff, then parked in the dead-letter table.
Postings carry an idempotency key so a replayed webhook never double-books.
Moving postings to the new partitioned table needs a dual-write window of one week.
The gateway in front of the card processor times out after 8 seconds and returns a 504.
Each merchant is limited to 50 authorisations per second; bursts above that get 429.
Certificates for the payment gateway rotate every 60 days via the secrets operator.
Card payouts settle at 02:00 UTC; anything later lands the next business day.
Our account manager at the bank prefers email and answers within a day.
Settlement files arrive by SFTP as fixed-width text and are parsed by the posting importer.
The production cluster runs at 70 percent CPU at peak; add two nodes before the holiday sale.
Kubernetes there is pinned to 1.29 until the ingress controller supports 1.30.
Etcd snapshots are taken hourly and copied to cold storage for 30 days.
Schema change review checklist: every schema change needs a migration plan, a rollback and a review from a second engineer.
We generate schema change diffs with the migration tool and post them for review.
The on-call rota rotates weekly on Monday at 10:00; swaps go in the rota spreadsheet.
Pager alerts for the on-call engineer go out by SMS and push; acknowledge within 5 minutes.
Deploy checklist: run smoke tests, check dashboards, announce the release in the deploy channel.
Release trains leave every Friday; a missed train waits for the next Friday release.
General retry policy for HTTP clients: three retries with exponential backoff and jitter.
The notification queue parks failed messages in a dead-letter queue for manual replay.
Idempotency keys on public API writes are stored for 24 hours.
A 504 from the load balancer means the upstream took longer than the timeout; check the upstream logs.
Public API rate limit is 100 requests per minute per token; bursts above that get 429.
Certificates for internal services rotate every 90 days; the secrets operator renews them.
The monthly settlement report sums payouts per merchant and goes to finance.
Our cloud account manager prefers a call for anything about the contract renewal.
Partner exports arrive by SFTP each night and are parsed by the import job.
The analytics database runs at 85 percent CPU at peak; consider a read replica.
Kubernetes upgrades happen on the staging cluster first, a week before production.
Database snapshots are taken nightly and kept for 14 days.
Parental leave requests go to HR at least eight weeks ahead.
The finance team keeps a paper ledger of petty cash in the office safe.
